name: Albert Cross
source:
Role: Bladeseer
Likes: Discreteness, Training
Dislikes: Troublemakers
Alliance: Neutral

A nascent Bladeseer, Albert establishes the party Caeruleum with Alice. Taciturn and inexorably rational, he’s infamous within the Adventurer’s Guild for his willingness to accept any quest. He carries a strange, nameless blade that easily cuts enemies; uniquely, it also functions as a catalyst for incantations.

[From the [url=https://www.blissfulberyl.com/empyrealdawn]official website[/url]]
